subject.title: Feishu: bot does not respond when @-mentioned in a reply message

question: Should maintainers repair/adopt the conflicting fork PR or ask for a fresh target-repo Feishu fix for this issue?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible, but the only exact open candidate is outside the target repo, conflicting, and previously reviewed as needing safer mention-gating and root-routing behavior.

options.title: Repair or replace the candidate
options.body: Use the fork PR as context, but land a current-main target-repo fix with bot-specific dropped-mention evidence and routing tests.

options.title: Wait for the fork author
options.body: Keep this issue open while asking the fork author to rebase and address the prior safety concerns with inspectable Feishu proof.

options.title: Defer Feishu reply work
options.body: Leave this as an open known Feishu channel bug without creating another repair lane until a maintainer can own it.

recommendation.title: Repair or replace the candidate
recommendation.body: Use the fork PR as context, but land a current-main target-repo fix with bot-specific dropped-mention evidence and routing tests.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the most recent Feishu mention-handling history and is the closest routing candidate for the safe mention-gating shape.
